product.title: Pearl Harbor, Dole, and Polynesian Cultural Center from Waikiki

description.text: See three of Oahu's most important cultural attractions in just one day with his small-group tour. You'll visit historic Pearl Harbor where you'll learn about WWII history in the US, continuing to the Dole Plantation to learn about the history of the state's pineapple industry. Transportation, equipment, and local commentary are handled so you can focus on Oahu's coastlines, valleys, and cultural landmarks. Ideal for travelers basing in Honolulu who want a guided Oahu experience without coordinating transport, gear, or admission tickets on their own.
